args.content: # Agent Journal (structured notes) ## Findings - TASK.md = Sphinx issue "Instance variables link to other variables of the same name in the project". - Root cause: `PyObject.doc_field_types` in `sphinx/domains/python.py` defines `PyTypedField('variable', ..., rolename='obj', names=('var','ivar','cvar'), ...)`. The `rolename='obj'` makes every `:var:`/`:ivar:`/`:cvar:` docfield entry emit a `pending_xref(reftype='obj', reftarget=)`. `PythonDomain.resolve_xref` (searchmode=1) fuzzy-matches any same-named object → wrong links across subpackages/classes, exactly the reported bug. - Fix applied (1 line, sphinx/domains/python.py:357): drop `rolename='obj'`. `Field.make_xref` (sphinx/util/docfields.py:66) then returns a plain node. - Byte-identical to upstream fix 918086b55 "Close #5977: :var: field do not create a cross-reference" (merged via PR #8638 — the panel's namesake); that commit is NOT an ancestor of HEAD (4b452338f, 2021-01-01 13:57 JST; fix 19:51 JST same day). - Proven by repro (two subpackages, `limit` global + `:ivar limit:` in class): before fix → 2 pending_xrefs (reftype='obj', reftarget='limit'); after → 0, rendered as plain `limit – ...` text. ## Decisions - Did NOT run pytest (TASK.md forbids); verified via scratch sphinx builds only. - Repro dirs `_repro8638/` and `_verify/` created inside the project (write_file refuses paths outside project folder) and removed after verification. - Shared campaign .venv: sphinxcontrib-* were 2.0.0 (require Sphinx>=5) and blocked every build; downgraded to 1.0.2/1.0.3/1.1.4 per setup.py (unpinned). sphinx itself is not pip-installed; working tree used via PYTHONPATH. ## Leads - Working tree left with only `M sphinx/domains/python.py` (1 insertion, 1 deletion). - Nothing committed, tests untouched.
